thread:
Alyssa: Planning check — webinar 'Benchmarking inference: cost vs latency' on Thu 2026-04-14. Need final reg page + Zoom preflight + recording postflow.
Mike: UX priorities: timezone auto-detect with manual override, 1-click calendar add, pre-fill title & company. Include dataLayer keys utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_medium, landing_variant.
Jordan: Routing: HubSpot list 'webinar-benchmark-2026'. Map UTM -> property source, add opt-in property 'opted_followup'. Small events (<500) use Zapier path; large events use Lambda direct ingestion.
Helen: Zoom settings: cloud-record, separate audio/video files, auto-captions on, panelists allowed to record. Keep cloud files 90 days then lifecycle to STANDARD_IA.
Alyssa: Need SRTs for clips and accessibility. Clip SLA: candidate clips within 2 business days, final 3 clips in 3 business days.
Mike: Clip gen plan: auto-scan transcripts for keywords (latency, quantization, batching) -> produce top 8 timestamp candidates; ops picks final 3; render via ffmpeg with burned captions for social.
Jordan: Lead scoring rules: attendance >=50% => tag lead:high. Clicked clip => engagement:clip. Played replay => watched:yes. When high engagement, push to AE queue.
Helen: Ingest flow sketch: Zoom cloud -> zoom-automator webhook -> Lambda -> s3://redwood-recordings/webinar-benchmark/{meeting_ts}/ -> trigger Otter.ai for SRT -> update HubSpot on watched/transcript requests. Zapier route: webhook -> Zap -> HubSpot update for small events.
Mike: Add UTM params to every replay/clip link: ?utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=benchmark_apr26&utm_content=clip1 so ad metrics tie back.
Alyssa: Reg page copy: emphasize live benchmarks + interactive Q&A + gated benchmark report. Include checkbox: 'I'd like a follow-up demo' (opt-in). CTA: 'Reserve my spot & get the report'.
Jordan: HubSpot payload example for devs: { email -> {{email}}, hs_lists -> [webinar-benchmark-2026], properties -> {landing_variant, opted_followup} } (send via POST).
Helen: Preflight Tue 2026-04-12 — tests: captions, cloud recording, co-host roles, recovery Zoom, bandwidth. Inviting Mike, Jordan, Alyssa.
Mike: I'll create host playbook with recovery room link and limits validation. Also test recording export & SRT pipeline.
Alyssa: Post-event sends: immediate thank-you + full recording + survey + report CTA; 48hr highlight email with 3 clips (30s/60s/2m) + SRTs + demo opt-in. Also an in-email mini-survey: Dedicated vs Private interest.
Ops-bot: Recording uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/webinar-benchmark/1746001234 by zoom-automator. Transcription job started (id: 9a7b). Otter.ai webhook attached.
Jordan: I'll prepare validation dataset for tagging & UTM attribution by Mon 2026-04-11.
Alyssa: Owners recap: Content (clips/copy) - Mike; Ops (ingest/transcript) - Helen; Growth (routing/scoring) - Jordan; Marketing (landing + emails) - Alyssa. I'll assemble checklist and draft emails by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
